test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The visitor has chosen Holmes to solve his problem because he believes that:

options.text: Holmes is inferior to Monsieur Bertillon who has a scientific mind
a study of his skull would be of great value to him
Holmes is an unpractical man more interested in people’s habits
Holmes is most suited in helping solve an extraordinary practical matter

solution:
The correct answer is "**Holmes is most suited in helping solve an extraordinary practical matter**"
